claims.claim: Codeine, the closest morphinan analog with a direct absolute oral bioavailability record, had F = 80.5% in healthy subjects after oral and intravenous administration, supporting F ≥ 20% for hydromorphone, which shares the morphinan scaffold, 4,5-epoxy bridge, N-methyl group, and phenolic C3 substitution.
